name: supercharged
description: A comprehensive set of scripts for setting up a developer-friendly macOS environment

scripts.update: npm run restore:dotfiles && npm run install:openwiki && npm run install:managed-tools && npm run install:skills && npm run install:codex-plugins && ./scripts/update.sh
scripts.update:with-backup: npm run backup:all && npm run update
scripts.update:dry-run: npm run install:openwiki -- --dry-run && npm run install:managed-tools -- --dry-run && ./scripts/update.sh --dry-run
scripts.update:only: npm run restore:dotfiles && npm run install:openwiki && npm run install:managed-tools && npm run install:skills && npm run install:codex-plugins && ./scripts/update.sh --only
scripts.backup:all: npm run backup:claude && npm run backup:codex
scripts.lint: shellcheck --shell=bash --severity=warning scripts/*.sh scripts/utils/*.sh tests/helpers/*.bash codex_config/hooks/*.sh && zsh -n scripts/*.sh scripts/utils/*.sh dot_files/.zshrc dot_files/.zprofile dot_files/.p10k.zsh && actionlint
scripts.test:watch: nodemon --watch tests --watch scripts --watch codex_config --ext sh,bats,md --exec 'npm test'
scripts.pretest: command -v bats >/dev/null || (echo '❌ bats not found. Install with: brew install bats-core' && exit 1)
